t: This is Lansdowne House, a building that was home to a remarkable group of artists. Charles Ricketts, a book designer, typographer and stage designer, lived here, as did his companion Charles Shannon, a portrait painter whose work hangs in the National Portrait Gallery. Later the portrait painter and sculptor Glyn Philpot lived here too, along with Vivian Forbes, a soldier, painter and poet who was Philpot's longtime partner. Philpot is best known for his portraits of figures such as Siegfried Sassoon.
